0x19ab453c.notice: Runs the entropy + access-control module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.admin: The address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (controls the entropy config + request setters).

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a Pyth Entropy randomness diamond — seeds AccessControl so the entropy config + request setters are admin-gated, and registers the IPythEntropyAdapter interface (ERC-165). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open). Companion to the {ERC2981Init} pattern — a first-class production deploy artifact.
